item.text: I’ll verify this against Mistral’s current official documentation and distinguish a first-party reranker endpoint from models you’d need to host yourself.

No. Mistral does not currently document a dedicated, hosted reranker model or `/rerank` API endpoint.

Mistral’s Search Toolkit supports reranking, but the documented options are components you configure yourself: `LLMReRanker`, `CrossEncoderReRanker`, and `RRFRanker`. It also explicitly supports bringing your own components. [Search Toolkit documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit#components)

The Mistral API exposes model-management and model-inference endpoints, but its model capability schema does not list reranking as a capability. [Models API documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/models)

You can therefore use a Mistral LLM as an LLM-based reranker, or host/use a separate cross-encoder reranker, but there is no first-party Mistral reranker endpoint documented.
